title: Contemporary East Nashville home
description:
Enjoy easy access to everything from this perfectly located home base. Contemporary East Nashville townhome. 10 minutes from downtown, brand new appliances, pet friendly, open and clean, and a short skip to all cool activities East Nashville. Front patio for a cozy night and a Baldwin piano downstairs for the creatives.

Townhome built in 2020 with small front patio. Hardwood floors, bright and open spaces. Quality furniture such as a large L shaped desk in one of the bedrooms perfect for anyone working from home.
